title: ProtoSeam: Lifting Classifier Training with Latent Gaussian Mixture Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.35174v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a lifted reformulation of supervised classification that improves the final accuracy of standard classifiers without changing the architecture at inference time. A network $N=N_2\circ N_1$ is split at a single semantic interface and one learnable prototype per class is inserted there. Training combines a quadratic consensus penalty that pulls $N_1(x)$ toward the prototype of its class with a classification loss of $N_2$ evaluated on samples drawn around the prototypes, while no gradient crosses the interface. At inference the prototypes are discarded and the unmodified network $N_2\circ N_1$ is used. Across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet with ResNet and vision transformer backbones, lifted training improves test accuracy by up to six percentage points over variants without lifting under a shared tuning protocol. Moreover, we provide theoretical justification of those results.

translated_title: ProtoSeam：利用隐高斯混合模型提升分类器训练
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种监督分类的提升式重构方法，能够在不改变推理时网络架构的情况下提高标准分类器的最终准确率。将网络 $N=N_2\circ N_1$ 在单一语义接口处切分，并在该处为每个类别插入一个可学习的原型。训练过程结合了二次一致性惩罚项（将 $N_1(x)$ 拉向其所属类别的原型）以及在围绕原型采样的样本上评估的 $N_2$ 分类损失，同时梯度不跨接口传播。在推理阶段，原型被丢弃，直接使用未经修改的网络 $N_2\circ N_1$。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 TinyImageNet 数据集上，配合 ResNet 和视觉 Transformer 骨干网络，在相同的调优协议下，提升式训练相比未提升的变体可将测试准确率提高最多六个百分点。此外，我们为这些结果提供了理论依据。
tldr: 该论文提出ProtoSeam方法，通过在网络内部语义接口处插入可学习的类别原型并阻断梯度跨接口传播，以隐高斯混合模型的形式重构分类器训练，在不改变推理架构的前提下将测试准确率提升最多六个百分点。
en_tdlr: ProtoSeam lifts classifier training by inserting learnable class prototypes at a semantic interface within the network with no gradients crossing it, improving test accuracy by up to six percentage points without modifying the inference-time architecture.
